item.title: Professional cornhole player, quadruple amputee faces murder charges in Maryland
item.description: Witnesses say Dayton James Webber, 27, was behind the wheel of a car in La Plata when he shot and killed the front-seat passenger during an argument Sunday night, according to the Charles County Sheriff's office.
